backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as a placeholder backend canister with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the implementation of a feature flag (ENABLE_ASK_AI_SECTION) to conditionally hide/show the Ask AI section in the dashboard.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files describing components, pages, utilities, and configuration files in the React application.
frontend/.env.example: Environment variable template documenting the optional VITE_WEBHOOK_URL override for the built-in default ActivePieces webhook endpoint.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining build draft creation, CI/CD pipeline execution, post-deployment verification steps, and webhook configuration with troubleshooting tips.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color system, light/dark mode support, and custom design tokens for the application theme.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component managing Internet Identity authentication state and conditionally rendering SignInPage or DashboardPage based on authentication status.
frontend/src/components/AskAI/AskAIModul: Ask AI interface component with question input, submit/clear actions, loading states, error handling, and AI response display requiring uploaded notes context.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: File upload component with drag-and-drop support, file selection for PDF/TXT/MD files, upload progress indication, and clear functionality.
A layout component providing the app's header with branding and sign-out button, main content area, and footer with attribution to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Quiz/Interactive: Interactive quiz component rendering multiple-choice questions with A/B/C/D options, highlighting correct answers in green and incorrect selections in red after submission.
frontend/src/components/Quiz/QuizSection: A React component that displays a quiz section with a collapsible card containing quiz questions, showing question count and providing hide/view and delete controls.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCard.tsx: A React component that renders a summary in a card with a delete button, displaying text content with proper formatting and prose styling.
frontend/src/components/WebhookSetupHelp: An empty file with no content.
frontend/src/config/features.ts: Feature flags configuration file that controls visibility of the "Ask AI About Your Notes" section, currently disabled.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: A React hook and context provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a comprehensive design system including colors, spacing, and dark mode theme for the application.
frontend/src/lib/activepieces.ts: API client for ActivePieces webhook integration that handles file uploads for note processing and AI question answering, with strict response validation.
frontend/src/lib/env.ts: Environment configuration module that provides webhook URL resolution with a hard-coded default ActivePieces URL and optional environment variable override.
frontend/src/lib/offlineNoteProcessing.t: Client-side note processing module that extracts text from PDF/TXT/MD files, generates comprehensive summaries (up to 5000 chars), and creates up to 10 quiz questions from the content.
frontend/src/lib/pdfTextExtraction.ts: Client-side PDF text extraction utility that dynamically loads PDF.js from CDN and extracts plain text content from all pages of a PDF file.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: TypeScript type definitions for quiz items, upload responses, and AI answer responses used throughout the application.
frontend/src/lib/webhookOverride.ts: An empty file with no content.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page managing file upload, summary display, quiz generation, and conditionally rendered Ask AI section based on ENABLE_ASK_AI_SECTION feature flag.
frontend/src/pages/SignInPage.tsx: Sign-in page with Internet Identity authentication, displaying login button and branding for AI Learning Coach application.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, typography plugin, container queries, and custom animations.
frontend/WEBHOOK_SETUP.md: Documentation for ActivePieces webhook configuration, explaining the default webhook URL setup and optional custom URL override via environment variable.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking features, architecture notes, and pending requests including replacing Internet Identity with username/password auth and hiding the Ask AI section via feature flag.
